title: Degree bound for correlation-immune juntas
statement: Let $r,k,d\ge 0$, and let $g:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$. Suppose $g$ depends on at most $k$ coordinates. Also suppose that every nonempty set of at most $d$ coordinates has Fourier coefficient zero for the real-valued function obtained from $g$ by interpreting its outputs as signs. Then the algebraic degree over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the encoding of $g$ is at most $k-d$, with subtraction taken in the natural numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ depends on some set of at most $k$ coordinates
each nonempty Fourier coefficient indexed by a set of at most $d$ coordinates is zero
